get.summary: Retrieves attack surface DNS vulnerability event details.

example.title: DNSSEC Not Configured
example.description: The domain does not have DNSSEC configured, which could allow DNS spoofing attacks.
example.impact_description: Without DNSSEC, attackers could potentially redirect users to malicious sites through DNS cache poisoning.
example.remediation_instructions: Enable DNSSEC for your domain by configuring DS records with your domain registrar.
example.evidence_network_data: DNS query results showing missing DNSSEC records

get.summary: Retrieves attack surface web application vulnerability event details.

example.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
example.description: The web application is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks in the login form.
example.impact_description: Attackers could gain unauthorized access to the database and extract sensitive information.
example.remediation_instructions: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements to prevent SQL injection. Implement input validation and sanitization.
